title: Stripe stats band
description: Centred light statement over four big figures between hairlines: one figure is lit at a time while a short indigo line glides along the rule above it. Below, a burst of thin indigo rays tipped with dots fans up from a warm glow. A small sun/moon switch flips the band dark.
notes: the lit-figure cycle and the gliding line are CSS (desktop only); off under reduced motion, where every figure stays ink
React state for the light/dark switch: needs hydration; leave out toggleLabel to hide the switch
name: stripe-stats

props.name: title
props.description: the centred statement; pass two strings to choose the line break

props.name: stats
props.description: four figures; one at a time is lit while the others rest in slate

props.name: dark
props.description: start in the dark variant (the band's own switch flips it)

props.name: toggleLabel
props.description: label of the light/dark switch, for screen readers; leave out to hide the switch
